# Privacy

This project is built with privacy by default. 

## Telemetry & Tracking
There is zero telemetry, tracking, or analytics built into these tools. 

## LLM Usage
When using an AI agent (like Claude Code, Antigravity, or Cursor) in conjunction with these scripts, please be aware that the AI agent itself may send the code, prompts, and schema structures it encounters to its respective backend (e.g. Anthropic or Google). However, the scripts and binaries provided in this repository do not independently intercept or transmit any data.

We recommend reviewing the privacy policy of the specific AI agent you choose to use with this repository.
